== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[BB-9E (Errata)]] (PC-E1), Virtual Set 17, as the PC published it on 21 April 2022, taken unchanged from the PC's card-image repository ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Dark/large/bb9e.gif holotable commit 3f7288d], file <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Dark/large/bb9e.gif</code>; a PNG file served under a .gif name). Not a recreation.
